name: Bread Upma
steps: Cut bread into 2 cm cubes. Slightly dry bread holds its shape better; discard any bread with mould.
Prepare the vegetables: finely chop onion and tomato if listed; dice or grate carrot and potato into small pieces for even cooking.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Let mustard seeds pop, add curry leaves carefully, and toast any listed peanuts until golden. Add onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add turmeric and the remaining listed vegetables. Cook for 5–8 minutes, covering briefly with a splash of the measured water if needed, until potato or carrot is tender.
Add salt and the measured water; let the tomato base simmer for 2 minutes.
Add bread cubes and toss gently for 3–4 minutes so the tomato seasoning coats them without turning them into paste.
Turn off the heat, add lemon juice and rest for 2 minutes before serving. Keep the texture soft but not wet.
tips: Cook one small test portion first and adjust the consistency and heat before cooking the rest.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
